original.title: Mia and the Little Bird
original.summary: Mia sees a tiny bird with a broken wing, learns how to help, and grows kinder through gentle action.

sentences.text_with_blanks: Mia loved to play with [[slot_toy]] on [[slot_place]].

The bird's wing was as soft as a [[slot_color]] feather.
Mia felt sad and wondered how she could help the little bird.
She thought maybe [[slot_friend]] could give her a good idea.
She almost tossed the bird onto the ground, but remembered the story about kindness.
Instead, she tucked the bird into a tiny blanket and whispered, 'Take care.'
The next day, Mia brought [[slot_snack]] and shared it with the bird.
The bird sang a bright [[slot_sound]] that made Mia smile.
The bird fluttered its wings and flew away, leaving a trail of glittering [[slot_color]] sparkles, and Mia felt warm inside for helping a friend.
